scope: Profile-scoped navigation and a durable read-only review queue for applications with supported question preflight UNKNOWN or FAIL results.

acceptance.queue_visibility: PASS; main navigation includes a Review Queue and filters the active profile's saved applications to question-preflight UNKNOWN or FAIL.
acceptance.explainable_blockers: PASS; items show the saved job and company, exact preflight result/reason, question ID/text, and recorded missing fact, answer, profile, document, or application fields. Missing mappings receive an explicit review explanation.
acceptance.existing_review_route: PASS; the only queue action opens the existing profile-scoped application detail and review workflow. It does not answer, save, continue automation, or submit.
acceptance.reload_and_profile_isolation: PASS; synthetic browser acceptance reopens the queue after reload and confirms another profile's empty queue does not reveal the first profile's application.
acceptance.pass_and_other_categories: PASS for this bounded slice; component tests exclude PASS preflight and another profile. CAPTCHA, login, sensitive question, low-confidence field, unsupported ATS, ambiguous submission, and document validation categories are labeled unsupported and not listed.
acceptance.side_effects: PASS; browser acceptance observes no write request while entering the queue and opening the existing review, zero application attempts, unchanged application state/confirmation during queue navigation, and no outside network request. Explicit question-answer review later in the existing workflow remains user-directed and separate.
acceptance.whole_requirement: PARTIAL; only persisted question-preflight blockers are centralized. The other MJ-REQ-196 review categories remain unsupported and unlisted; no live employer ATS or external submission was exercised.

red_first_observation.details: The new frontend test initially failed because application-review-queue did not exist. After implementation it passed while verifying UNKNOWN and FAIL details, PASS exclusion, active-profile filtering, and navigation-only actions.
